$comment: Machine-readable snapshot of the tower catalog and progression rules, exported from src/towers.ts.

eras.name: Primitive Defense
eras.blurb: Timber, stone and a steady hand.

eras.name: Advanced Engineering
eras.blurb: Precision weapons, radar and armour-piercing rounds.

towers.name: Archer Tower
towers.desc: A timber watchtower with a long bow. Cheap, quick, and the backbone of any first wall.

towers.name: Cannon Tower
towers.desc: A stone emplacement and a powder charge. Explosive shells scatter a small pack.

towers.name: Ballista Tower
towers.desc: A braced torsion bow throwing an iron bolt clean through a file of enemies.

towers.name: Frost Tower
towers.desc: A runed pillar of river ice. Shards chill a walker and can hold the weak in place.

towers.name: Gatling Tower
towers.desc: A hand-cranked rotator bank. Weak rounds alone, but the barrels spin up while it fires.

towers.name: Mortar Tower
towers.desc: A rifled tube that lobs a heavy shell far down the lane and carpets the road where it lands.

towers.name: Flame Tower
towers.desc: A pressurised oil jet. Washes a cone of fire over everything close and leaves it burning.

towers.name: Tesla Tower
towers.desc: A copper coil fed by a steam dynamo. Lightning leaps from one body to the next.

towers.name: Sniper Tower
towers.desc: A long-barrelled precision rifle on a survey mount. Picks out the toughest target in reach.

towers.name: Missile Tower
towers.desc: A guided rack. Missiles steer into a moving target and detonate on contact.

towers.name: Radar Tower
towers.desc: A dish and a plotting table. No gun of its own: it feeds targets to every tower nearby.

towers.name: Heavy Autocannon
towers.desc: A belt-fed cannon with tungsten penetrators. Armour counts for very little against it.

towers.name: Laser Tower
towers.desc: A solid-state emitter on a tracking gimbal. No shells, no travel time — just a held beam.

towers.name: Plasma Tower
towers.desc: A magnetically bottled plasma bolt. Energy burns straight through plate and bursts on impact.

towers.name: EMP Tower
towers.desc: A capacitor bank that dumps its charge in a ring. Everything caught in it stops dead.

towers.name: Accelerator Tower
towers.desc: A rail assembly that charges, then flings a slug down a straight line of bodies.

towers.name: Quantum Tower
towers.desc: A probability projector. Its shots exist in two damage states until they land.

towers.name: Singularity Tower
towers.desc: A contained collapse. Its shell drags anything nearby back the way it came.
towers.ability: Pulls enemies backwards along the lane

towers.name: Drone Nexus
towers.desc: A hangar and three autonomous hunters. Each drone picks its own target.

towers.name: Storm Generator
towers.desc: An ioniser that seeds a thunderhead over the lane and calls down strike after strike.

towers.name: Artillery
towers.desc: Artillery — coming in a future update. A command battery meant to blanket the whole field.
